name: replace_in_files
description:
Replaces occurrences of a pattern across multiple files in ONE call.

This is the preferred tool for repeated small edits (renames, import swaps, annotation changes,
path prefixes) spanning several files or many places in one file: one call with a SHORT pattern
replaces many single-file replacements with long disambiguating needles.

Recommended protocol whenever there is ANY risk of unintended replacements:
1. Call with dry_run=True: every prospective change is returned as a minimal line diff with an
   occurrence id; nothing is modified.
2. Call again with dry_run=False, passing the ids you want in occurrence_ids (omit it to apply
   all). You pick the desired replacements from the list - no counting, no needle-crafting.

For clearly unambiguous bulk replacements you may skip the dry run; pass expected_count as a
guard. If the actual number of matches differs, NOTHING is changed and the diff list is
returned, so a failed guard costs one call and gives you the dry-run output to select from. Returns in a dry run, the prospective changes; otherwise a summary of the applied replacements.

dry_run.description:
If True, do not modify anything; return the prospective changes as a list of
diffs with occurrence ids.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

expected_count.description:
Optional guard for calls without occurrence_ids: the number of
occurrences you expect to be replaced. If the actual count differs, nothing is changed and
the list of prospective changes is returned. -1 disables the guard.
expected_count.title: Expected Count

max_answer_chars.description:
If the output exceeds this many characters, a shortened version is
returned. -1 uses the configured default.
max_answer_chars.title: Max Answer Chars

mode.description: Either "literal" or "regex", specifying how `needle` is to be interpreted.
mode.title: Mode

needle.description:
The string (mode "literal") or regular expression (mode "regex"; Python `re`
syntax with DOTALL and MULTILINE) to search for.
needle.title: Needle

occurrence_ids.description:
Optional list of occurrence ids (obtained from a dry run) to which the
replacement is restricted; if any id is unknown or stale, NOTHING is changed. If omitted,
all occurrences are replaced.
occurrence_ids.title: Occurrence Ids

paths_exclude_glob.description: Optional glob of files to exclude; takes precedence over the include glob.
paths_exclude_glob.title: Paths Exclude Glob

paths_include_glob.description:
Optional glob (relative to the project root, e.g. "src/**/*.java")
restricting which files are considered.
paths_include_glob.title: Paths Include Glob

relative_path.description: Only consider this file or directory (default: the whole project).
relative_path.title: Relative Path

repl.description:
The replacement string. In regex mode, backreferences to matched groups can be
specified as $!1, $!2, etc.
repl.title: Repl
